english: Beside the buried statue, you see someone up on a ledge.
There's grunts echoing down the chamber, along with the sound of iron against stone.
You hear the sound of... working.
Grunting. Clanging. And so on.
A dwarf? Down here?
Could be a trap.
Hello up there!
Identify yourself, citizen!
(Clear your throat.)
E-Nah.
You do so. But it gets drowned out by the noise.
(Clear your throat much, much louder.)
Hey, I'm talking to you!
Huh?
The dwarf's smoldering eyes widen as he sees you.
Look Romulus, we've got an official visiting!
If that doesn't make us official, I don't know what will!
Peeking out over the ledge you spot an orange monster creeping about.
A Rust Monster. The dwarf appears friendly with it. How strange.
Rust Monsters are known to devour metal. Keep your distance.
And, uh... he mutters and leans out. "Nice bucket!"
And, uh... he mutters and leans out. "Nice pot!"
What is that thing?!
Is that a Rust Monster?
What are you doing here?
Do you have a license for... this?
Get down from there.
What a find!
Good. He's playing along.
He believes you are doing a bit.
You are.
Such wonderful loot!
Oh, no worries! That's just Romulus.
He's very kind. The dwarf then mumbles to himself, "When he's fed."
Ominous.
Oh yes! Very correct. But no worries!
Me? Oh. You know.
He lets out a smoldering laugh. "A dwarf's got to have a hobby!"
Mining in ancient ruins is not a hobby. It's a profession.
License?
Didn't think you needed one to risk your life down here!
He's got a point.
Nah. Took me ages to get this seat.
We can talk like this! It's fine.
Insubordination.
He puts down his tools and strikes a pose.
Let me introduce myself. I am Akzel Mâdsson!
A dark dwarf.
Or as they prefer, Underdwarf.
Pleasure to meet you! You're a Norvikian cleric, I presume?
Not just. I'm The Cleric. Of Norvik.
I'm more of a rogue, really. The sneaky kind.
I'm actually more of an arcane spellcaster.
...Yes. (Don't be complicated.)
I'll be damned!
Not sure what it means, but it sounds expensive!
It means everything.
A... rogue? Rogue what?
Just rogue, you know.
A rogue actor in a world of conspiracies.
Maybe 'thief' is a better title.
I know?
You know.
He shrugs and says, "Sure! Why not?"
Sounds grim! I like it.
Same.
Oh. I suppose, uh... cleric kleptomaniac does sound catchy!
It really does.
Oh. So a wizard?
Yes. Uh. Indubitably.
Sure. If you want to put it simply.
A cleric-wizard. Yes.
Don't use that word.
A perfect word for a perfect mind.
Magic music?
That's it.
Huh. Haven't seen one of those for a while.
...I'm really more of an aspiring Bard, but still.
Got it.
I see!
You're a bit small for that, aren't you?
How dare he.
Don't try me.
I'm working on it.
(Look sad.)
He laughs.
Ah, be whatever you want to be! It's a free realm!
Oh. So, like a mix?
Yeah. Probably.
I'm aiming for full Druid by the end of next quarter.
Good for you!
A wise choice. Simplicity is strength.
He looks around. "And you're here all alone?"
Yeah.
Why do you care?
Of course. What kind of man wouldn't be lonely?
No, it's just...
Deep.
Hah! Go' knaegt!
Then I very much suggest not going into the hallway back there.
Listen to him. He knows these tunnels well.
It's one of those ancient esoteric traps. Still functional.
It'll burn your beard off.
You triggered it?!
I'm impressed you're alive!
So are you.
Not sure how much experience you have with this City Below the City...
But most people who come down here... they die.
Even clerics do not venture down alone. Don't you have some backup?
You need no backup. You are the backup.
Backup would be nice, actually.
Not really.
What?!
Then what's your... goal?
You cannot possibly just be taking a stroll down here, can you?
I'm supposed to meet up with some goblin chieftain?
Oh. Oh!
You're here on business with Lady Sageleaf?
Then you should go to her right away. Before you end up mimic food.
Mimics. Horrible creatures. They could be anywhere - anything.
Meek not horrible, your shuffling cloak whispers in your ear. "Meek is... useful-helpful. Promise."
Get yourself some backup. Just some friendly advice.
I don't need backup. I'm really, really powerful.
That's probably a good idea. Thanks.
But you're down here alone?
He shows you his palms. "Alright. Good luck then."
He doesn't believe you.
He gives you a thumbs up.
Universal symbol of approval. Who doesn't love a good thumb in the air?
No I'm not.
I've got Romulus!
The monster makes a high-pitched shriek.
Adorable. In a horrifying way.
But what are you doing here? (Look around at his strange setup.)
Oh! And you've got a goblin with you!
You HWBT, friend?
Yeah. You're that dungeoneer looking for cats, right?
Cats?
More or less! Hope your lady wasn't too mad about my inquiry!
I'd say 'annoyed' is a better description. But it's fine. Just don't trespass anymore.
Will do! Or... I won't, I mean. But I should correct you. I'm not a dungeoneer.
I'm more of a... er...
With a bright smile he adjusts the collar on his uniform.
Well I... I'm what you'd call a historian with ambition!
As he says it, the orange beast sends an echoing hissing noise down the chamber.
Exactly, Romulus!
We're here on an expedition of grand proportions.
To find the legendary Missing Mine of Toul'Amon! Of Toulin'catl!
The snailfolk. Ancient builders of the City Below.
Tool-in Cattle?
The snailfolk. I see.
That sounds like a quest.
Good luck with that. I actually have some questions...
Yes, Toul'Amon, of Toulin'catl!
An ancient people of great esoteric might.
Nothing compared to the Arcanists of course. But still impressive, for Beasts of Jor.
Those weird snailfolk.
I figured you'd know of them!
Those weird, weird snailfolk.
Oh, yes indeed!
A QUEST. Your ears perk up.
But just to be clear, I'm not sharing the spoils just like that.
Fair enough. Treasure is earned.
Of course! I'm a bit of an expert on the subject, you see...
No. Not about that missing mine. I have some other questions.
...Okay. Tell me more about this lost mine.
...Mm. Okay then.
Great!
He wipes his brow and yells down to you.
Hey there!
What do you know about the tea shop?
I've got a bunch of personal questions for you.
Why are your eyes glowing?
E-"Good luck down here."
You do?
Er... maybe later. I've got a bunch of work to finish up here.
But I'll be at the Drunk Sphinx once I'm finished! Ask me there, and I'll gladly indulge you!
A tavern. Good place to extract information.
Haven't met too many Underdwarves, have you?
Look, I don't have too much time, but really, once I'm done here I can talk all you want.
Mm.
He crosses his arms and gives you a long nod.
It's a type of café. You know, they serve tea and other drinkables.
Sometimes they even have pastries. I love Kardemum Treats.
I also love Kardemum Treats!
No, no. The tea shop.
How long have you been down here?
O! My friend, you are truly of good taste.
A man of CULTURE, this dwarf.
He clicks his tongue.
Is... is there some special tea shop I should be aware of?
About a week, by now.
Takes time to set up a secure perimeter.
A week alone in the City Below? He really is an expert at this.
So you don't know about the tea shop that exploded?
Exploded?!
I thought the election was bad enough as it is. Now they've got exploding tea shops?!
Norvik is in trouble, indeed!
Oh well, he mutters with a shrug. "Can't help you there, friend."
So here's the deal. I'm in trouble.
His 'pet' makes a loud belching noise.
Right? he mumbles, and gives the monster a pet on the back.
You want to help, friend?
Help a stranger? That's how heroes are made.
Help a stranger? That's how fools are robbed.
I will help you if I can.
I'll help if I get paid.
I might help, if I have time.
I won't help, unless it's by accident.
Sure, I've got some loot to share if that's the case.
Smart. Always negotiate upfront.
Fair!
Sure, I'll take a possible accident.
Accidents happen. Especially around you.
You see, there are two strange ruins in this section of the City Below the City.
He points at the statue. "Whitemane ruins. Before the dwarves and humans, and even trolls, this place was ruled by cats."
Cats - ruling an empire?
The theory goes, the snails of Toulin had an esoteric mine not far from the Pillar of Jor.
The Mines of Toul'Amon! A place of thick veins with endlessly growing amber and platinum...!
Endless treasure...!
But the walking god of the Whitemane, for whatever reason, sealed it shut at some point. According to legends.
Sealed esoterically, probably, since we can't seem to locate it.
Esoteric seals can be broken. With the right knowledge.
So you're looking for it.
How can you hide an entire mine?
So there's ancient snail-folk, and then slightly less ancient cat-folk who built cat-stuff on top of the snail-stuff?
M-"So what's the problem?"
Oh yes! I'm not alone in this, of course.
But my research has shown me clear indications that these two ruins below Tolstad are more or less unexamined. At least by skilled hands!
Your hands are skilled. Very skilled.
You'd be surprised! The City Below the City is...
What is it... four or five levels of sprawling tunnels and caverns. Here under Tolstad it's only this here top level that's in any way accessible.
There could easily be some crevice far down that no one, not even the city's greatest paladins, have gotten close to discovering.
The deep places of the world hold many secrets.
Exactly!
Layers upon layers. Like a corpse cake.
There's no problem with this site.
But I'm almost finished here. And I am unable to gain access to the second Whitemane ruins.
Because it's inside HWBT territory! And they are very unwilling to allow a dwarf like me past.
Those goblins have hired a brutish bugbear as a guard.
He shivers. "Horrid creature."
Your lovely goblin friends have hired a brutish bugbear as a guard.
But you're a cleric! If you can get access into their territory, then please, head south!
Through the damp high-caverns. There should be a Whitemane ruin at the end. A shrine. Probably marked by a bunch of feline symbols.
He gestures towards the giant statue. "Just look for big cats, essentially."
You can't get access yourself?
What do you want me to do there?
Aren't you the little spelunker. That's good. He nods.
Did you see anything?
Just dust. And rubble.
Nothing too interesting.
Depends. What are you looking for?
He laughs, loudly. "No way, hombre!"
Lady Sageleaf has made it very, very clear that there is to be no dungeoneering in her dank tunnels.
No comment.
Especially by outsiders. So no, that's not happening. Not while she's the leader of the HWBT.
He leans over the edge. "All I need you to do, is tell me if you find a symbol of a sun, or two blades."
Either of those. Then report back to me!
If you're able. And if you have time.
He sighs. A deep, frustrated sigh. "Wish I could do it myself. Darn those goblins."
No offense, he adds, giving your companion a nod.
None taken. I really, really do not care.
I'll see what I can do.
Don't expect anything.
Great! Since you've already made your way there, it shouldn't be too much of a hassle, I hope.
Great! And good luck.
Thank you, friend.
I never do.
Nothing will come. Nothing...
Yes?
And I found the symbol. On the ruins.
The symbol of a sun?
Yes.
He lowers his head, letting it hang for a while.
Then he lets out a roar!
<shake>For helvede</shake>!
His little buddy joins in and screeches.
That's not a good sign.
The dwarf takes a deep breath.
A sun means those ruins are just the same as these, he says and taps the stone beside him.
They're consecrated! The Whitemanes would never consecrate a secret gate.
Damn it!
Well. Sorry.
Too bad!
Are you certain?
Bah! Don't be!
Agreed!
Oh, absolutely. I've spent years researching these cat-bastards.
Even learned some cat-speech!
Me llamo Akzel! Es un caballo blanco!
He groans.
As do you.
That's not cat-speech. That's not even close.
Guy's not entirely off, Snell whispers to you.
I know what I'm talking about, okay?
This means only one thing.
This lead was off. He scoffs.
Oh well. Time to regroup and rethink. After the election, that is.
Here.
He tosses his pickaxe to you.
That's a little trick we have in the delving business. A custom made Detect-Secret-infused pickaxe.
A magical item. As payment. Not bad.
Detect Secret?! This is very useful.
You're giving this to me?
That's a nice reward. Thanks.
Sure is, bror!
Of course!
You've earned it, Cleric of Norvik!

Of course, the pickaxe is a bit wonky. The keyword is supposed to be, 'secret' - as in, you say the word, 'secret' and the pickaxe casts the spell. But it doesn't quite work, so... do with it as you please!
Wonky magic items can be dangerous. Or hilarious.
Anyhow, I'll be packing up soon. I'm done here.
Thanks again. Saved me a ton of time and effort!
Maybe in a few months you'll join me for a real expedition? Could be fun!
A real expedition-quest. Into the depths...!
That sounds like a death wish.
I'll think about it.
I would love to delve with you, Akzel!
I don't think so.
Think hard and long! You've got time!
Never say no! Just say maybe! Think about it!
And if there's anything else, just let me know!
